display.purpose: The hero promise on two lines, in the serif; up to 6.5rem (S11), capped by --fit per language from the real text column. The Antes / Después specimen words and the offer's promise (L119: sans 400, line-height 0.98, -0.035em, max 14ch) take this size in Albert Sans.

headline.purpose: Albert Sans 400, -0.025em, 1.1 (L111): one per section (.head, revealed word by word), the case page's single h1, the contact email and place lines.

title.purpose: Albert Sans 600, -0.015em (L111): case chapter headings (.subhead), method card lines, offer ledger titles.

sheet-title.purpose: Albert Sans 600, -0.01em (L111): titles of plates, sheets, plots, list groups, decision records, register dates, contract days and footer columns; the disclosure label (--fs-lead).

wordmark.purpose: The serif at the title size: the header's 'Lautaro Guebel' (and its LG monogram) and the footer LG. With the hero promise and the italic captions, the only serif on the page (L111).

lead.purpose: Lead paragraphs in Albert Sans (--fs-lead); the hero lead sits on a glass panel.

body.purpose: Running text in Albert Sans, and buttons at weight 600.

label.purpose: The header's links and ES · EN (Albert Sans, all in ink), the header action at 600, detail and status text (--fs-small).

caption.purpose: Small serif italic under the case pages' plates and sheets; the home's figures carry none since the live canvas (L113-L116). Also the contact lines' labels, the ledger's struck old way and the case facts' terms.

shadows.name: floating-phone
shadows.purpose: filter on the drawn phone that holds the illustrative screen; the only shadow in the system (glass and mica cast none, T23).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals, presses and the flow's lit/pop steps (--ease-out).

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The cable's branch drawing into the flow; the track fill between hops.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The envelope's hop from station to station: leaves quickly, settles without passing.

motion.name: t-press
motion.purpose: Press feedback: scale 0.97 on buttons, 0.985 on composer options.

motion.name: t-hover
motion.purpose: Hover colour and underline changes (fine pointers only).

motion.name: t-reveal
motion.purpose: data-reveal entrance (16px rise + fade), word reveal per word, cable station fill.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Delay step between staggered reveals (--i) and between the words of a heading (--w).

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Cross-page view transition on the root.

motion.name: shutter
motion.purpose: Pictures settle into their frame from scale 1.04.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: Hero promise lines rise from their clip; lead and action fade up from blur(6px) in 700ms.

motion.name: flow-sequence
motion.purpose: The protagonist: branch 420ms, envelope pop 480ms, four hops of 600ms, each station lit 520ms.

motion.name: feed-entry
motion.purpose: A new event-log entry arrives on top; the oldest fades under its line.

motion.name: living-plates
motion.value: hero 18s camera, 7s sway, 9s smoke, 12s gust; footer 16s camera, 6s sway, 8s ripple, 44s canoe
motion.purpose: Ambient loops of the engraved plates.

motion.name: word-reveal
motion.purpose: Section headings split by Words.astro into .w spans; each word rises 0.35em out of blur(6px) and fades in.

motion.name: header-hide
motion.purpose: The pill header slides up past the hero while reading down; back on scroll up, focusin or an anchor jump (+160ms). Never under reduced motion.

motion.name: scrollspy-chip
motion.purpose: The lighter chip slides under the link of the section read (IntersectionObserver band at 40%).

motion.name: hero-scroll
motion.value: exit-crossing: frame translate 0 7% + scale 1.06, far band 5%, cane scale 1.08
motion.purpose: Scroll-driven parallax and zoom on the hero engraving (longhand translate/scale over the loops); glass panels never move.

motion.name: footer-scroll
motion.value: entry: scene from scale 1.08, far band from -5%, near from 1.12
motion.purpose: The footer engraving settles as it scrolls into view.

motion.name: stack-sink
motion.value: exit-crossing, a fifth per card, scale to 0.90-0.975
motion.purpose: Covered method cards sink back while the next slides over; sticky top 88px + 20px per card (stack.js).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions off, smooth scroll and view transitions off, SMIL layers removed, no scroll-linked depth, headings whole, method a plain list, header never hides; flow static and complete, log still, cable fully drawn. Without animation-timeline support only the loops and plain sticky stacking remain.

radii.name: radius-panel
radii.purpose: Plates, sheets, glass panels, the phone sheet, method cards, the contact card, the event log.

radii.name: radius-control
radii.purpose: Composer topic rows, the disclosure summary, estate plots.

radii.name: radius-inner
radii.purpose: A picture on a plate's mat, parallel to the plate's corner.

radii.name: radius-pill
radii.purpose: Every .btn, the header's three pills, its links, the scrollspy chip, the ES · EN targets.

surfaces.name: mica
surfaces.purpose: Plate paper made translucent: every .plate, the phone sheet, composer rows and draft, contact card, disclosure. Opaque under prefers-reduced-transparency, 0.92 where nothing blurs.

surfaces.name: glass
surfaces.purpose: The thicker fill over the hero's engraving: its lead and action panels only (the header is brushed metal since L108). Ink 7.7:1 over the darkest stroke unblurred; 0.9 where nothing blurs.

surfaces.name: glass-blur
surfaces.purpose: backdrop-filter of mica and glass; -webkit- prefix in its own @supports; none under prefers-reduced-transparency.

surfaces.name: glass-rim
surfaces.purpose: The 1px rim of light and brighter top edge of every mica and glass sheet; inset light, not a frame.

surfaces.name: brushed-metal
surfaces.value: background-color: rgb(234 229 216 / 0.92); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), linear-gradient(100deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 20%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55) 42%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 64%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.45), rgb(221 214 196 / 0.4)); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
surfaces.purpose: The header's wordmark and nav pills (L108). Opaque --tone and no blur under prefers-reduced-transparency.

surfaces.name: metal-rim
surfaces.purpose: Rim of the brushed-metal pills (--metal-rim; on the wordmark through a ::before layer).

surfaces.name: liquid-moss-metal
surfaces.value: background-color: var(--sage-ink); background-image: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 30% -20%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.38) 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 55%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1) 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 48%, rgb(31 42 34 / 0.22) 52%, rgb(31 42 34 / 0.05) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.45), inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(31 42 34 / 0.35), 0 0 0 1px rgb(31 42 34 / 0.18); text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(31 42 34 / 0.35); color: #fff;
surfaces.purpose: Every primary .btn (L110); hover base color-mix(in srgb, var(--sage-ink) 78%, var(--ink)) = #445d41. White label 5.7:1.

surfaces.name: ink-band-panel
surfaces.value: background: rgb(251 246 230 / 0.05) (ledger) or 0.06 (picture mat); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), 0 0 0 1px rgb(251 246 230 / 0.08)
surfaces.purpose: Faint lighter sheets on the offer's ink band (L117-L118), no blur.

surfaces.name: method-card-ring
surfaces.value: background: var(--plate); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9), 0 0 0 1px rgb(31 42 34 / 0.1)
surfaces.purpose: The opaque method cards on the sage band (L114).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The action: a pill of liquid moss metal (the sage ink with a specular glow top-left, a mid band and a rim; L110), white sans 600 with a 1px engraved shadow, 44px, the label followed by a drawn 1.5px mark (envelope or arrow) that steps 2px forward on hover. Only actions wear it.
components.html: Escribime por email

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Underlined inline link; the underline thickens on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 0.07em; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; transition: text-decoration-thickness var(--t-hover) ease; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 0.14em; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Plate with caption
components.description: A figure on a sheet of mica: translucent plate paper, blur, a 1px rim of light, 14px corners; sans 600 title on top, italic serif caption under it on the case pages (the home's figures carry none since L113-L116).
components.css: .ds-sheet { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); } .ds-plate { background: rgb(251 246 230 / 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.3); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); border-radius: 14px; padding: var(--plate-pad); display: grid; gap: 14px; } .ds-sheet-title { margin: 0; font: 600 var(--fs-lead)/1.25 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-plate p { margin: 0; font: 400 var(--fs-body)/1.65 var(--sans); } .ds-caption { margin-top: 10px; font: italic 400 var(--fs-small)/1.45 var(--serif); color: var(--ink-2); }

components.name: Composer option
components.description: A topic row of the message composer: a row of mica on the 10px control radius with the rim of light, like a segment of a control; the radio drawn as a survey station (14px ink ring; chosen: ink dot in a sage band) and the chosen row on the sage wash.

components.name: Ledger entry

components.name: Event log line
components.description: A register line beside the plan, on a plate with 14px corners: tabular timestamp, a drawn sage check, the event. The log's 'sample data' sentence is a sr-only figcaption (L116).

components.name: Disclosure summary
components.description: The real graph's summary on phones: a row of mica on the 10px control radius, sans 600 label, a drawn plus inside a 14px ring that becomes a minus.

components.name: Method stacking card
components.description: A step of 'Cómo trabajo' on the sage band (L114): an opaque plate with 14px corners and a fine ink ring, what happens on the left and the sheet it leaves on the right, no caption; the five stick under the header 20px apart and the covered ones sink back as the next slides over.

components.name: Offer band
components.description: Where the owner decides (L117-L120): the section on the ink field, the promise across at the display size in the sans, the sage intro, the moss-metal call to action with the arrow mark, the picture on a faint plate mat, then the ledger. No closing sentence.

components.name: Site icon
components.description: The serif LG drawn as paths in plate paper on a 14-unit-radius tile of the moss metal (specular glow, mid band, rim; the edge turns plate under prefers-color-scheme: dark). favicon.svg and the 16/32 ICO use a sturdy drawing; the 180 touch icon (opaque, full bleed) and the 512 icon a finer one. Generated by scripts/make-icons.mjs (T24).

narrative.northStar: The Hand-Coloured Atlas of Tucumán, under mica
narrative.overview:
The site reads as a bound atlas. Two engraved landscape plates open and close it: the cane fields and sugar mill under the hero's promise, the lake and chapel under the footer. Between them, the engineering work is drawn as surveyor's plans in the same green-black ink: a flow of five stations on a pencilled track with a compass rose and a scale bar, an estate of plots for the club's system, a ledger for what a business can do on its own. A small business is mapped and put in order the way a cane estate is surveyed. The world was pinned by the user ("Me gusta muchos los colores (beige) y estetica tranquila que tiene el hero y footer. Quiero poder plasmar eso en el resto de la pagina"), so the build extends the plates' palette and calm to every section.

The calm + modern pass (S12, L100-L101) lays that atlas under sheets of mica: "Quiero mezclar el estilo tranquilo con algo moderno", with a frosted-glass dashboard ("es como una mica o un estilo ui de iphone") and a pill navbar as references. Figures sit on translucent, softly rounded sheets with a rim of light; text over the engravings sits on thicker glass; actions are pills; the header floats as three pills; the engravings move with the scroll, headings come in word by word and the method's steps stack as cards. The palette and the drawn plans are unchanged: the modern layer is material and motion, not colour. A designer's note (L111: "acompañemos la tipografia de la serif con otro tipo de tipografia para que no sea tan pesada y no se vea tan "vieja"") then moved the headings and titles to the sans too: the serif is kept for the hero's promise, the captions and the wordmark.

The impeccable live canvas (L108-L120) then tuned the page by hand with the user, element by element, and turned the modern layer into metal where it is touched: the header's name and links became brushed-metal pills ("un poco mas metalizado"), every action became a pill of liquid moss metal ("un efecto de liquid metal verde musgo"), the method was set on a sage band so it stands out ("debe resaltar mas"), and the offer became the page's one dark field, the ink band where the owner decides ("aca se debe decidir y actuar"), opening on a display-size promise and a call to action. Captions the reader did not need were removed from the home (L123: "es info extra que no necesita el lector").

Density is low and the tempo is slow. Each section has its own composition, and a section is separated from the next by space and by a change of ground (paper, sage, straw, ink), never by a rule. Colour is watercolour wash on rag paper: a cream ground, a brighter plate paper for figures, a sage wash for the automation case and the method, a straw wash for the padel case, and brick only where something fails or is struck out. The action is the moss metal: the sage ink, lit like metal, on every button; forest green, the action of earlier versions, now only marks a few written states and hovers.

The world explicitly refuses the SaaS landing: saturated colour bands, blueprint grids and rows of same-size cards (direction contract, THESIS).
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground; figures on sheets of mica (translucent plate paper, blur, a rim of light, 14px corners), never on ruled frames.
Metal where the hand goes: brushed-metal header pills and liquid moss-metal action pills, both lit by layered light, never by a drop shadow.
Green-black ink for text and for every drawn line; washes carry case identity (sage = automation, straw = padel); two full bands mark the page's turns: the method on sage, the offer on ink.
The atlas serif only for the hero's promise, the italic captions and the wordmark; Albert Sans, self-hosted, for every heading, title, reading text and control.
Diagrams in 1–1.5px ink linework with hatching, a compass rose and a scale bar where a plan is shown.
Soft corners on surfaces (14 / 10 / 6px), pills for actions and the header; circles for drawn marks and stations.

One protagonist animation (the automation plan drawing itself), with scroll-linked depth on the engravings, word-by-word headings and stacking method cards. Static and complete without JS, without scroll timelines or with reduced motion.

rules.name: The Moss Metal Is the Action Rule
rules.body: Only an action wears the moss metal, and every action wears it. Washes carry case identity (and the method's band); ink as a field marks the offer alone; brick carries failure; forest green is limited to the caret, the email row's hover and written "accepted" states. Nothing else gets colour.

rules.name: The Wash Is the Case Rule
rules.body: Sage belongs to the automation case and straw to the padel case. A wash appears outside its case only as a small node fill inside a plan (straw for ends and the envelope, sage for retries and lit stations).

rules.name: The Pencil Is Not Ink Rule
rules.body: `ink-3` draws non-text lines only; any text uses `ink` or `ink-2`.

rules.name: The Mica Is Paper Rule
rules.body: Every translucent fill is an existing paper, wash or ink with alpha, never a new colour or a white veil. The white in the metal is light (brush lines, sheen, specular, rim), laid over a palette fill, never a fill of its own.

rules.name: The Six Sizes Rule
rules.body: Text uses the six size tokens and nothing else. A new size is a design change, not a tweak.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif for the hero's promise, the italic captions and the wordmark, nothing else; Albert Sans for every heading, title, reading text and control. Never a third face outside real data.

rules.name: The Atlas Caption Rule
rules.body: A figure's caption sits under it in small serif italic, never above it, never in tracked capitals. A caption is there only when the reader needs it: on the home a figure speaks for itself; a disclosure that must stay (sample data, an illustrative screen) moves to the alt text or to screen-reader text, never disappears.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only on real measured data (the timestamps of the event log), with tabular figures. Never as a "technical" costume.

rules.name: The Margin Lane Rule
rules.body: The outer inset belongs to the cable. Nothing else is placed in it.

rules.name: The Tone Step Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by a step in paper tone, a wash or a sheet of mica, never by a line.

rules.name: The Only Floating Thing Rule
rules.body: Only the drawn phone casts a shadow. Plates, glass, metal pills and buttons rest flat: no offset, no blur radius under anything (T23 removed the lift S12 had put under the hero's glass and the header's pills; the live canvas's metal kept to rims).

dos: **Do** set every figure on a sheet of mica (or a wash's mica); on the case pages give it its italic serif caption under it, on the home only when the reader needs it.
**Do** dress every action, and only actions, in the moss metal (sage ink lit as metal, white label), and give each case its wash: sage for automation (and the method's band), straw for padel.
**Do** draw diagrams as survey plans: ink lines 1–1.5 units, pencilled tracks, brick hatching and dashes for failure, a compass rose and a scale bar where a plan is shown.
**Do** use only the six size tokens for text; the serif for the hero's promise, the italic captions and the wordmark, Albert Sans for every heading, title, reading text and control.
**Do** use the four radius tokens: panel for surfaces, control for rows and plots, inner for a picture on a mat, pill for actions and the header.
**Do** put text over an engraving on glass, and keep glass over the hero's picture only; the header's pills are brushed metal.
**Do** separate sections with space and a change of ground (`--gap-section`, paper → plate → wash, the ink band for the offer).
**Do** mark list lines with filled shapes (dash, dot, square) instead of boxes or bullets.

**Do** make every animation start from a visible, complete default, tie scroll motion to `translate` / `scale` inside `@supports (animation-timeline: view())`, and switch it all off under reduced motion; keep one protagonist (the plan).

**Do** keep text AA on every ground: ink or ink-2 on paper, plate, sage, straw and mica; ink only on glass and metal; plate and sage on the ink band; white on the moss metal (5.7:1); brick and green-deep only where their measured contrast holds (6.1:1 and 6.0:1).
**Do** embed the generation prompt in every new shipping raster, give each slot a 2x candidate and tone photos to the paper.
donts: **Don't** use saturated colour bands, blueprint grids or rows of same-size cards (the SaaS landing the world refuses).
**Don't** put a label, kicker or eyebrow above a heading, number sections, or use tracked uppercase labels.

**Don't** put an offset or blurred shadow on anything at rest, glass and metal included; the drawn phone is the only floating object. Rims, 1px rings and the button label's 1px engraved text shadow are light, not lift.
**Don't** divide content with hairlines or outline boxes in 1px lines; the 1px rim of light on mica is inset light, not a frame, and ink linework belongs to drawings and marks.
**Don't** invent a radius or a translucent colour: every corner is a token, every fill an existing paper or wash with alpha.
**Don't** use monospace outside real data, or `ink-3` for any text.
**Don't** use text glyphs ("+", "→") as icons; draw them as SVG in the 1.5px ink line.
**Don't** name technologies, tools or frameworks, or show a GitHub link, anywhere in text, alt, aria-label or title.

**Don't** use gradients as fills. The one use is light on metal (the buttons, the header pills, the site icon): white and ink layers over a palette fill, never a colour gradient. Masks are only for blending the engravings into the paper.
exceptions: **Two hairlines:** the 1px `ink-3` separator above the real workflow graph (canvas comment if01muum), now bounded to the plan under it (`min(68rem, 100% - 2 × --plate-pad)`, 420px where the tall plan stands in), and the footer's 1px closing hairline (L67). No other rule lines.
**The "venta" highlight:** the straw fill behind one word in the flow heading (L56).

**The footer:** its black text, #504e42 / #474640 inks, #e9e2cf / #ebe4d2 lines and the 6px-radius icon box come from the user's reference and stay local to it. Its serif link columns were part of that pin (L67) until L111: the user asked for the lighter type across the whole page, so the columns and the closing row are now in the sans; only the "LG" stays serif.

**System serif as the display face:** pinned by the user (artboard-02 typography). The earlier pin of the display size "up to 10rem" is superseded by the designer pass (S11, L93): the display now tops out at 6.5rem.

**Glass, metal and pills (S12, L108, L110):** the frosted surfaces, the floating pill header and its brushed metal, and the liquid-metal buttons were asked for by the user ("Vidrio + esquinas suaves", "Header en píldoras con scrollspy", "debe ser un poco mas metalizado", "liquid metal verde musgo") against the taste skill's "no glass, no floating pill navigation, no gradients, flat buttons" house rules; they stay as decided.
